set.acceptance: Go workflow tests: BuiltinNames lists plan and its file parses with steps interview, milestone-check, review, critic, check, revise, gate, open-pr, wait-pr, pr-green, rebase, wait-rebased, rebased-green, merge and close-out, the gate passing to open-pr and close-out ending the run; the review step's prompt names only {change} and rhiza guide plan-review, and the interview step's prompt names the rhiza-plan skill. A testscript runs rhiza run start --workflow plan with fake agents and a fake gh on a draft change set through the gate to open-pr, and the run's branch is rendered and committed: git status is clean, rhiza check passes, and no plan file is written.
set.statement: The binary ships a built-in plan workflow: an interview agent step driven by the rhiza-plan skill, then a milestone-check command step (rhiza run milestone-check) that ends the run failed when a change set the plan makes serves no milestone, then rounds of a fresh review agent step told only the change set's ID, a critic agent step and rhiza run review-check, with a revise agent step on a failed check, then rhiza run gate, and after it the ship steps open-pr, wait-pr, pr-green, rebase, wait-rebased, rebased-green, merge and close-out. It writes no plan file.
